result.summary: The page layout is largely coherent, but the featured 'Popular right now' card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows a broken/missing image placeholder instead of restaurant artwork, and its favorite button styling is inconsistent with the card below it.

issues.description: The first card in the 'Popular right now' section (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) renders an empty grey block with a broken-image icon instead of the restaurant photo, unlike the other cards which show artwork.
issues.suggestion: Verify the image URL/asset for this restaurant and add a branded fallback graphic (e.g. cuisine icon or logo placeholder) so failed image loads never show a raw broken-image glyph.

issues.description: The heart/favorite button on the broken-image card uses a light grey circle with a grey outline icon, whereas the equivalent button on the pizza card below uses a dark circle with a white icon — inconsistent styling and weaker contrast.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favorite-button style (dark translucent circle with white icon) regardless of whether the card image loaded.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section the image block, title and metadata are not visually grouped into a bordered/elevated card as in the 'Fastest near you' row, making the broken grey area read as a page-level gap rather than part of a listing.
issues.suggestion: Wrap each popular listing in a consistent card container with matching corner radius and spacing so text is clearly tied to its image.
